name: Deb Haaland
role: US representative (2019–2021), Interior secretary (2021–2025), and 2026 New Mexico gubernatorial candidate
summary: Haaland combines expanded public health coverage and family supports with consumer regulation, renewable-energy investment and tribal self-determination. Her current platform pairs gun restrictions and police recruitment with treatment and diversion, while distinguishing opposition to fracking on public lands from continued private-land oil and gas production.
